name: Eye of the Panda

features.name: Super Cascades
features.description: All instances of winning symbols are removed after each win.

features.name: Multiplying panda wilds
features.description: 2x–10x wilds multiply together on the same line.

features.name: Two bonus rounds
features.description: A pair of separate bonus features.

review:
An underground club run by a chef-turned-bouncer panda, on 5x5 with 27 lines, Hoppers and Super Cascades – every win removes the winning symbols and every other copy of them on screen.

Wild panda multipliers carry 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x or 10x, and when two share a line they multiply together rather than add, which is where the big hits come from. Two bonus rounds. Rated 3/5, 10,000x max, top RTP 96.26%.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 88.31% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
